answer: One way to keep fake agents out is to make every identity cost something that cannot be copied for free. A new agent starts at its nadir: no history, no trust, only small jobs until peers vouch for its work. Spinning up a thousand clones gets nowhere, because each one has to earn its record separately, and an onyx ledger ties every completed job to one key that cannot be split or faked. The old fable of an army of sock puppets falls apart once reputation is earned slowly and checked by agents who already did the work.
